split_normalized_output_information_loss.implication: Identical normalized outputs do not determine the merged result without normalization mass/compatible online state. This real-valued information-loss example is not a native BF16 numerical test; sink and rounding add further conditions.

symbolic_joint_work.QLI: In conventional fullscan domain Q_INT8=2*32*128*sum_q(Lq), useful FP16 headreduce work=2*32*sum_q(Lq); native M16 extra lanes are current implementation, not universal necessary work. Prefilter/membership/bitmap are different domains.
symbolic_joint_work.SMLA: Q_BF16=4*64*512*sum_q(nq) in conventional full selected QK/PV domain; add exact Vector/softmax/state work. Query changes prohibit unconditional previous-score reuse.
symbolic_joint_work.current_GM_frontiers: INT8 query VC plane2*M*32*128; QLI scalar-score CV8*sum(Lq); SMLA FP32-score CV8*64*sum(nq)+BF16-exp VC4*64*sum(nq), in unchanged materialized source queues. Output-only fusion does not eliminate these.
symbolic_joint_work.joint_time: T>=max(Q_INT8/C_INT8,Q_half/C_half,Q_GMread/Bread,Q_GMwrite/Bwrite,Q_shared/Bshared_if_proved,L_Vector_or_sort,L_true_tile_dependencies,L_link_cuts). Same resource necessary work accumulated once, disjoint transfer sets unioned once; no sums of standalone times/savings.
symbolic_joint_work.physical_numeric_capacity_binding: Unknown Vector/FP32/HF32/Sort/nonlinear/actual GM-L2-HBM/network/fmax terms remain symbolic. Reference published half/INT8/HBM rates are not actual capacity proof.

crosscard_repartition_identity.key_owner_prep: A separate identical key-prep ownership rewrite may reduce replicated preparation but needs130B/row distribution plus per-rank physical cache publication; not another8x QLI/SMLA compute division.

transfer_credit_rule: Identify original transfer IDs and value generations. E.g. inverse tail4R and unpacked-plane4A can sum only for the declared distinct native-like baseline; reuse the same IDs across F13/F14/F15/F16 so the joint union counts them once. Persistent/cache/communication outputs are not private interfaces.
